integrity: The proof reconstructs the commutator and conjugacy classes from the group law, identifies the graph with a complementary symplectic clique blow-up, and derives all claimed graph invariants from symplectic linear algebra. The checker independently enumerates the relevant structures in five finite cases.
scientific_limitations: The group is the standard finite Heisenberg group with one-dimensional center.
The projective symplectic graph spectrum used in the proof is prior work.
The prime-field n=1 boundary is already covered by the known center-index-p^2 theorem.
The theorem does not classify arbitrary class-two groups.
title: Commuting conjugacy class graphs of finite Heisenberg groups are symplectic clique blow-ups
